.]] The massive Stonewrought Dam is located east of Dun Algaz pass, along Loch Modan's northern border.
Storm crows (or stormcrows) are a species of crows found on Azeroth. They are sometimes summoned by Druids of the Talon.
Stormcaller's Garb is the Brood of Nozdormu set for shamans.

Storm giants are titan-forged giants who were afflicted with the Curse of Flesh. They are found in Northrend and are led by King Gymer. However, the storm giants were recently decimated by the Lich King, who had the Scourge raise them back into undeath, or use their corpses to create mindless flesh giants. They were also used to create the stitched-together aberration known as Thrym.
The Stonewall Girdle is a plate belt that gives a bonus to stamina.
Stormfire Gauntlets are a quest reward from Reagents for Reclaimers Inc. (4).
Stonewall Canyon is a wide gorge that runs along the west side of the Thrallmar plateau.
Stormcaller is a main hand sword that gives major bonuses to spell damage and spell critical rating, and a smaller bonus to stamina and intellect.
Stonewood Hammer is a quest reward from Centaur Bracers (Classic).
Storm Helm is crafted with Blacksmithing (365); taught by Plans: Storm Helm, a world drop.
The Stormbringer Belt is a world drop from level 17 - 22 mobs.
Stormforged Axe is crafted with Outland Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Stormforged Axe.

Stonevault Rockchewers are troggs found in the non-instanced area of Uldaman. They are mostly found in the North Common Hall and South Common Hall areas. They are members of the Stonevault group, found all over the ancient ruins. The troggs have been disturbed by the dwarves' explosives, used while mining. They now prevent any further exploration of the halls.
:Were you looking for Stop the Fires! (Horde)? Stop the Fires! is a daily quest related to the seasonal world event Hallow's End.
Stormchops are created by Outland Cooking (1); taught by Recipe: Stormchops.
__NOTOC__ Storm Wyrms are thunder lizard creeps that can be encountered in many tilesets. They are the strongest variant the creeps family. An Ancient Storm Wyrm could be found in The Druids Arise.
Stonewing Slayers are gargoyles found between Windrunner Village and Windrunner Spire in the Ghostlands.

The Storehouse is an area of Lower Blackrock Spire, where Blackrock orcs store their weaponry, armor, and ammunition. It is presided over by Quartermaster Zigris, who contiously barks orders to his underlings as he inspects the crates and barrels. The Storehouse is accessible by going upstairs from Urok Doomhowl's ledge, and turning left up the next set of stairs. Halycon's Lair is right down the hall.

Storm spirits exist on the Elemental Plane they appear as globes of lightning. If summoned by shamans as Lightning Guardians, the spirits protect them from harm by striking out against anyone foolish enough to attack the shaman protected.

The Stonewall Lift is a seldom used mechanical device that uses chains and box-like cages to move up and down from the top to the bottom of a cliff on the southeast coastal corner of Howling Fjord just east and slightly south of the Explorers' League Outpost.
Stormfleet Deckhands are humans working on The Stormbreaker in the Borean Tundra.
These quests play out the Storm Peaks storyline. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement The Summit of Storm Peaks.

Stormcrest Hatchlings are the young of a special breed of Snowy Eagles, Stormcrest Eagles, they are rather large, much larger than the rest of the eagles in Azeroth. The Frostborn breed these hatchlings nearby Frosthold.
Storm, Earth and Fire is a talent in the Elemental Combat tree. You will need to spend 35 points in Elemental Combat to max it.
__NOTOC__ Storm Tempered Keepers are stone keepers in Ulduar. They are found in the Observation Ring where Auriaya patrols.
Storm Beacons are large destructible buildings that can be found throughout the Iron Concourse in Ulduar.
Stormcrest is a peak directly east of Frosthold. It is covered with Stormcrest Eagles and their nests.
Storm Capper is a player vs. player achievement earned for personally carrying and capturing the flag in Eye of the Storm.
Storm Glory is a player vs. player achievement earned for personally capturing the flag while having 4 bases.
The Storm Bay tribe is a tribe of murlocs found in the Bay of Storms in Azshara.
__NOTOC__ Stormforged Champions are located at Nidavelir in the Storm Peaks.
Stormforged Artificer are located at Narvir's Cradle in The Storm Peaks.
The Stormforged Eradicator assist the Stormforged Monitor in retrieving the core in Frostgrip's Hollow in the Storm Peaks.
The Stormchild was a boat temporarily ensconced in Menethil Harbor. Its captain was Marcus Windthorne.
Stormforged Ambushers have a chance to spawn from Dead Iron Giants when they are mined with a Diamond Tipped Pick during Forging a Head.

Stormcrest Eagle Eggs are found in numerous stormcrest eagle nests high up in the Storm Peaks. The harpies have grown a taste for eagle flesh, they are caring for the eggs long enough to feast on the hatchlings. The eggs are needed for the Alliance quest Baby Stealers.

The Storm's Fury is a world event that runs for two hours every five hours in the Primalist Future of Thaldraszus. There is no lockout, so players can complete the The Storm's Fury (world quest) world quest as often as they like. Players are breadcrumbed to the event from Zawarudu atop the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken, who offers Storm Warning. Soridormi then offers Resisting the Storm, asking players to complete the event. Neither quest is required to participate in the world quest, however.

__NOTOC__ Stormbeak is a gryphon located in the Commons of Ironforge. He is accompanying Stormcaller Mylra. He is later seen in Deepholm and the Twilight Highlands, further accompanying Mylra. Stormbeak continued to accompany his master throughout the Burning Legion's third invasion, serving both as her mount and battle companion. He also accompanied Mylra and Duke Hydraxis during the Battle for the Exodar. In the Vision of Orgrimmar, Stormbeak is summoned by Sian'tsu to assist her in combat.
Stonewing Trackers are level 16-17 gargoyles found around the ziggurats in the Ghostlands.

Stood in the Fire is an exploration achievement earned for being killed by Deathwing, either at random in the world, or in the two encounters with him in the Dragon Soul raid (Spine of Deathwing and Madness of Deathwing).
Stormbolt Gloves is purchased from , the Wildhammer clan quartermaster in Thundermar, Twilight Highlands for at Exalted reputation.
Stormforged Breastplate is crafted with Blacksmithing (500); taught by trainers.

__NOTOC__ Stormcaller Jalara is a draenei shaman of the Earthen Ring located in the Temple of Earth in Deepholm and later in the Twilight Highlands. She finally meets her doom at the hands of n'raqi while escorting Thrall to Wyrmrest Temple.

The Storm Cliffs are the cliff directly east of the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara. The Spitelash naga take up residence here. The Ravencrest Monument can be found at the far east of the cliffs.
Stopping the Rituals is about disturbing the ritual gems used by the satyr of Satyrnaar and Xavian.
The Storm Rider is a storm dragon that has been captured by Twilight's Hammer and is being held in the Bastion of Twilight.
Storm Furies are air elementals located in the Sanctuary of Shadows in the Black Temple.
Stormborn Myrmidons are orcs found in the Eye of Eternity in Dragon Soul.
Stormforged Giants are iron giants located in the Halls of Lightning.
Stormforged Constructs are iron golems located in the Halls of Lightning.
Stoppered Vial of Muddy Water is created automatically after filling the provided, leaky, Mudmug's Vial.
Stormbreaker is a meta quest achievement earned for completing of most other Pandaria quest achievements on the Isle of Thunder. It rewards the title , which appears after the player's name.

Storm's End is a title awarded to players upon completing Heroic: Lei Shen by slaying Lei Shen, the last boss of the Throne of Thunder, on heroic mode. The title appears after your character's name: :, Storm's End

The Storm-Stave of Antonidas is acquired by using the Staff of Antonidas, provided by Lady Jaina Proudmoore for Securing A Future, upon Lei Shen's dais on the Pinnacle of Storms in the Throne of Thunder raid instance.
Stormbringer Draz'kil is a Zandalari troll in Throne of Thunder.

Stormblast is an instant Enhancement shaman attack that strikes an enemy, dealing 450% weapon damage and applying a 15-second debuff that increases the critical strike chance of Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Earth Shock and Lightning Shield spells against the target by 25%. It is the Ascendance version of Stormstrike.
Storm Lashers are lashers located in the Conservatory of Life in Ulduar.
Storm Armor is a level 100 shaman talent, added in Warlords of Draenor. It is granted to Elemental & Enhancement shamans choosing Rainstorm.

Stormfang was the frost wolf companion of Geyah. When she was bitten by a drift lurker and fell into a coma, it stayed next to her with Durotan and together they protected her. When a large group of garn attacked the three, Durotan entered in a blood frenzy and accidentally killed it. Durotan would skin and wear Stormfang's pelt for the rest of his life, not only as a constant reminder of the old wolf's courage and loyalty, but that even the most noble of orcs can fall prey to bloodlust.
Storage House Key drops from Blackhand in Blackrock Foundry on Raid Finder mode.

Stormbreaker Reykir is a vrykul located at Hrydshal in Stormheim.

Storm of Swords is an Arms warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Arms of the Valarjar and Soul of the Slaughter traits.

__NOTOC__ Stonewarden Quarry is an excavation site located deep within the Runewood of eastern Stormheim. The location belongs to the cult of vrykul mystics known as the Bonespeakers, and appears to be an integral part of their rune-making rituals. The site is also occupied by a number of elementals fashioned by the Bonespeakers to guard it.

Storm Silver Ore can be mined from Storm Silver Deposits and Rich Storm Silver Deposits, as well as Storm Silver Seams. It may also be looted from mining certain enemy mob corpses. It has a chance to be contained in caches awarded from PvP activities such as battlegrounds and player bounties.

Storied Maldraxxian Boneblade is a quest reward from the following Shadowlands quests: *A Valuable Find: Halls of Atonement *A Valuable Find: Plaguefall *A Valuable Find: Theater of Pain *A Valuable Find: Sanguine Depths It summons an Undying Bonekeeper.

The Stonevigil Overlook is the westmost settlement within the Village Ward, connecting to the Wildwall for access to the Castle Ward and Darkhaven. The Forest Ward lies to the west and Witherfall Ruin to the south. It is accessible from the Feeders' Thicket as well.

Stonewrought Sentry is a toy item looted from Forbidden Chamber Lockbox in Revendreth. To open the lockbox, the player must first pick up a Discarded Anima Canister and drain anima from Silent Observers inside the tower. Once the canister is filled, use the new extra action button on the Chamber Guardian until it unlocks the door to the lockbox.
Stormborn Infernals are infernals located in the Maelstrom during A Ring Unbroken.
